notes.title: Update 1.28.1 in now live on all platforms
notes.content:
[p]The Common eland has arrived in Tikamoon Plains – a true giant among antelopes and a worthy challenge for any hunter. Strong, resilient, and majestic, the eland will put your tracking and shooting skills to the test. This update also brings a range of gameplay improvements and refinements. Aiming now feels smoother thanks to reduced blur on iron sights, and the zeroing for the Prairie Hunter the Jack iron sight has been adjusted to 50 meters for more accurate shots. We’ve also refreshed the audio experience with updated sound effects for the Steyr-Gams rifle and several rifles from the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1288320/eventcomments/524225948489431410/"]Hunter’s Advantage Pack[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/f50963085dcfc7ee887346524884fa2d2d506117.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Update 1.28.1 also brings important fixes inspired by your reports. The electronic caller delay has been resolved, its UI now updates correctly, and the hunter sense dot alignment on the Prairie Hunter the Jack has been corrected. We’ve also smoothed out some localization issues and minor environmental glitches, like the levitating grass on Nez Perce Valley. For more details, please check the patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Design the Future Reticle with Integrix[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Alongside this patch, we’re excited to share something special. We’re teaming up with [url="https://www.leapers.com/brand/integrix/"]Integrix Optics[/url] to design a brand-new custom reticle, and we want your help. Whether you’re a hunter in the field or in-game, this is your chance to shape how it looks and works.
[/p][p]The survey is short and simple and your submissions will help us and Integrix Optics shape the final design of the new scope. notes.title: Update 1.26.7 is now live on all platforms
notes.content:
Update 1.26.7 brings several key improvements to Way of the Hunter. PC players can now enjoy FSR2 and DLSS presets for better visual quality and performance. Multiplayer features a location ping system, join and leave notifications, and an upgraded server browser with map details and difficulty levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/9a65f15c1fe4f8eb2e159f6c295432a7a3db3654.jpg[/img]

We’ve also improved the herd management info on the hunting map, made the encyclopedia more user-friendly, and refined HUDless mode for a more immersive experience. Additionally, we’ve fixed several bugs, including shotgun reload issues, audio glitches, and floating trees in Transylvania - for more details, please check the patch notes below.

[h3]Enhanced Hunting Map UI 
[/h3]With this update, we're introducing an enhanced Hunting Map UI, providing clearer insights into animal herds, their habitats, and the impact of your hunting activities. This update makes herd management more accessible by allowing players to track herd fitness over time and see how their hunting choices affect populations. Previously, manual note-taking was required, but now, after each in-game year, you can easily view herd fitness levels on the map, helping to refine your strategy for more effective and sustainable management. For detailed info on this feature, we’ve prepared a full breakdown [url=https://ninerocksgames.com/posts/update-1-26-7-strategic-habitat-management-and-herd-fitness]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/bdc5ea9d847a37ce97cbb52f205db4816cebe760.png[/img]

[h3]Game version 1.26.7 (Build: 145687) patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added: Herd management UI: 
[list][*]Selecting an animal group in the Hunting map now displays fitness information 
[*]Animal groups in the Hunting map now carry a badge, denoting if they belong to a private, primary, or secondary habitat
[*]The in-game clock in the Hunting map now also shows how much of the current in-game year has passed
[*]A new tutorial page in the Encyclopedia explains the mechanics behind these additions[/list]
[*]Added: (PC) FSR2: Added with adjustable presets
[*]Added: (PC) DLSS: New preset options available
[*]Added: A notification when the player’s ammo has been refilled
[*]Added: On lower difficulties, a marker will now be automatically dropped at the place of a blood trail origin where an animal was hit
[*]Added: Multiplayer:
[list][*]Added a Location ping functionality
[*]Added join/leave notifications
[*]Server browser now displays the map and difficulty of each server[/list]
[*]Tweaked: Improved the experience of playing with the HUD hidden (e.g. previously hidden HUD information will now be shown temporarily)
[*]Tweaked: The Encyclopedia will now automatically reopen at the last viewed page

notes.title: Upcoming Updates for Way of the Hunter
notes.content:
Hi, Hunters!

We know you’ve been waiting for an update and we truly appreciate your patience. While we hoped to share news sooner, we can now provide a clearer picture of what’s ahead for Way of the Hunter.

First of all, let’s address the moose in the room. We understand that new DLC maps have become one of the major regular announcements based on our past release patterns. However, we want to be upfront and let you know that we are not currently working on a new DLC map.

Instead, this year will be about improving and expanding your gameplay experience on the existing maps in meaningful ways.

[h3]What's on the Horizon
[/h3]In a few weeks, we’ll be releasing a patch focused on quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and technical enhancements. This update will include multiplayer refinements and improvements to herd management, all designed to make your time in the wild even better.

We already knew herd management was important to you, but your responses in the survey made it even clearer - you love managing your herds. This upcoming patch is our first step in directly addressing what we’ve learned, and we hope you’ll love the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/3390782d29d0cb711780ab01892cad24978c4cc2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Looking Ahead
[/h3]This year we will be rolling out regular updates aimed at both long-time players and newcomers alike. If you're looking for more things to do, there will be more to hunt and display, along with additional equipment to enhance your experience.

Beyond fresh content, we’re addressing key areas of feedback from our recent survey and ongoing discussions on Discord, Reddit, social media platforms, and Steam. Expect game-wide refinements and improvements in both single-player and multiplayer modes, all shaped by survey insights and ongoing conversations in the community. We’ve also identified a few major community-requested features and will soon determine their development order.

Thanks for being part of this journey, we can’t wait to share more with you soon!

[b][h2]More Survey Highlights!

[/h2][/b]We’ve carefully reviewed the survey results, so let’s take a moment to revisit some of the key takeaways.

[h3]Favorite Missions & Story Rewards
[/h3]Hollywood took the spotlight as the most praised mission, loved for its emotional depth, unique trophy, and personal connection. Respondents appreciated the tradition and the challenge of hunting the legendary deer with diverse antlers right at the start. As for story mission rewards, most respondents enjoy the thrill of unlocking special weapons and rewards - what a nice surprise! We’re thrilled you’re enjoying those sweet rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/18befa4bcf54b15a29b807df8ce1f9dc9f146c2c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Satisfaction and Audio Preferences[/h3]
73% of players are either extremely or very satisfied with the current gameplay! Plus, 92% of you keep in-game audio enabled, and we’re dedicated to enhancing our sound design for an even more immersive hunting experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/1f73ccdce9ebbd9dbc33ac2b566993e0a967d089.jpg[/img]

[h3]Character Customization and Vehicle Preferences
[/h3]The most requested customization feature? More weapon options! Players also expressed interest in expanded clothing choices and updates to physical features. Regarding vehicle preferences, opinions were nearly split, but UTVs emerged as the top choice for hunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/eeadb24765ae4d79319599452c643258828ae5d7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Rare Fur Encounters
[/h3]Most hunters agree, that 5 rare fur encounters after 50 hours of gameplay is the sweet spot. We’re committed to delivering more of these memorable moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/612f6f9a52c209a78c6bc65ec98ff2fe1a5b54c8.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]The Hunt Continues

[/h2][/b]While there’s no new map in the crosshair, more content, equipment, and gameplay improvements are definitely in the pipeline. Your feedback remains the backbone of Way of the Hunter’s evolution, and we look forward to sharing more details soon.

Thank you, and happy hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/952c89a1e7e9f0e85b5807074bfd2ab6ddc02ed6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Steyr Arms Pack for Way of the Hunter is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/4884738bf488dbec11cafeaf4dd3b6a14b2f6dc6.png[/img]

[b]New Steyr Arms Pack for Way of the Hunter is available now![/b]
 
Bratislava, Slovakia / Vienna, Austria - October 19, 2023: Today, THQ Nordic released the new Steyr Arms Pack for Way of the Hunter! The Steyr Arms Pack is available for $4.99 and includes the following rifles:

[h2]Steyr-Gams[/h2]
The brand new Steyr-Gams, which will be available in Way of the Hunter exclusively before it is even sold in stores.
The Steyr-Gams is the ideal rifle for high alpine hunting, based on the proven Ultra-Light rifle. It features an optimised scout barrel and an integrated picatinny rail for precise optics mounting. The innovative combination of carbon stock and state-of-the-art 3D printing technology creates an ultra-light rifle of the highest quality and precision.

[h2]Steyr SSG M1[/h2]
Intended for mid-sized big game, the SSG M1 rifle can meet the most demanding mission requirements. Based on traditional virtues like precision and reliability, it also boasts a new multi-function chassis not found in any other rifle.

[h2]Steyr Mannlicher Cl II Fullstock[/h2]
High reliability, maximum precision, convenience of use, the Steyr Mannlicher CL II is one of the better options when it comes to dealing with the biggest and most dangerous game.

[h2]Steyr Monobloc ARMAD Green-Brown[/h2]
An all-steel weapon made according to military standards for ultimate ruggedness. New "monobloc" construction—the barrel and housing are made from a single piece for unbeatable accuracy. A top ergonomic stock with numerous, innovative options for customization. This limited edition uses high-grade ARMAD steel and features a green-brown finish.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584760/

The Steyr Arms pack introduces 4 new hunting rifles to Way of the Hunter, including the Steyr-Gams – a newly announced high alpine hunting rifle available in Way of the Hunter exclusively before it is even sold in stores.

Featuring an optimised scout barrel and an integrated picatinny rail for precise optics mounting, as well as the innovative combination of carbon stock and state-of-the-art 3D printing technology, the Steyr-Gams is an ultra-light rifle of the highest quality and precision.

The Steyr Arms pack also adds the Steyr SSG M1 for precision and reliability, the Steyr Mannlicher CL II Fullstock for the biggest and most dangerous game, and the all-steel Steyr Monobloc ARMAD Green-Brown for ultimate ruggedness.

Watch the trailer here: https://youtu.be/mzXpknwXBbI

We also recently released a roadmap, giving you an idea what's coming soon to Way of the Hunter!

[*] New scopes

[*] Camera movement (head bobbing) improvements

[/list]
